text:
carmen: quick ping — need security review for PR #4921 (onprem auth + secrets rotation). trying to merge today if possible. main changes: switch to customer KMS, add env gating, remove plaintext fallback. any blockers?

raj: quick look — can you drop the PR link? also the static linter flagged missing audit hook around KMS encrypt.

carmen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4921 — main diffs in pkg/auth/kms.go and deploy/onprem/helm/values.yml

olivia: skimmed and left a couple inline nits. main security asks: 1) add rotation grace-period check + unit test, 2) confirm no plaintext secrets in helm charts (values.yml should only contain placeholders). will re-review after those.

mike: onprem note — values.yml currently has secret placeholders but we still need sealed-secrets or ExternalSecret integration. I can help convert charts this afternoon. ETA EOD.

sasha: can we gate merge with a label like "security/approved"? also CI must pass infra-scan job. saw one flaky staging test recently; might need a restart if it flakes.

security-bot: static-scan completed — 1 HIGH: missing audit log for kms.Encrypt call in pkg/auth/kms.go:83; 2 MEDIUM: helm values contain potential secret placeholders. Full report: https://scans.internal/1795002468/4921

raj: thanks @security-bot — @carmen can you add a quick audit.Log(ctx, "kms.encrypt", meta) on success path? that should address the HIGH.

carmen: yep will add audit log and push in ~10m. also rebasing on main now.

olivia: :thumbsup: ping me when pushed, i'll re-run review live.

mike: once merged, remember to coordinate onprem rollout — increment chart version and run helm upgrade in staging with sealed secrets. command we use:
```
helm upgrade --install redwood-onprem ./chart -f values.staging.yml --namespace redwood
```

sasha: tagging @platform to schedule a short deploy window in ~2h. platform, any conflicts?

platform-bot: deploy window scheduled 15:30 UTC -> 16:30 UTC. no conflicts detected.

carmen: pushed commit 7b3f8a0 — added audit log and unit test for rotation grace period. updated PR.

olivia: reviewed updated changes — LGTM pending CI green. adding label "security/approved".

security-bot: infra-scan passed. unit tests: 42/43 ran, one flaky requeued.

raj: i'll give final approve once CI is green. also adding a post-merge note in the PR with runbook steps for KMS rotation and secret rotation script.

carmen: merging now. thanks everyone :pray:
